name: IPhone SE

images.credit: Micaman45., CC BY-SA 3.0 via Wikimedia Commons

Network.Technology: GSM, LTE, 3G, 4G, EDGE, UMTS, HSPA+, DC-HSDPA, CDMA, EVDO

Memory.Storage: 16, 32, 64, or 128 GB NAND connected via NVMe

Display.Display: 4.0 in Retina Display, LED-backlit IPS LCD, 1136 × 640 pixel resolution (326 ppi, aspect ratio 16:9) with full sRGB standard, 500 cd/m2 max. brightness (typical), 800:1 contrast ratio (typical)

Cameras.Rear camera: Backlit Sony Exmor RS IMX315 12.2 MP (4032 x 3024, 1.22 μm), dual-tone LED flash, autofocus, IR filter, burst mode, f/2.2 aperture, 4K video recording at 30 fps, 1080p at 30 or 60 fps, slow-motion video (1080p at 120 fps and 720p at 240 fps)
Cameras.Front camera: 1.2 MP, f/2.4 aperture, exposure control, face detection, auto-HDR, Retina Flash, 720p video recording

Sound.Sound: Mono speaker, 3.5 mm stereo audio jack

Battery.Battery: 3.82 V, 6.21 W⋅h (1624 mA⋅h) built-in rechargeable LiPo

Connectivity.Connectivity: Near-field communication (NFC), Bluetooth 4.2, GPS, GLONASS, Wi-Fi (802.11 a/b/g/n/ac), VoLTE, Wi-Fi calling, Lightning connector, 3.5 mm stereo audio jack
